card.name: Space before a dose number
card.fires_on: The space (or the first digit) just before a dose amount or threshold number, mostly in epoetin and darbepoetin dosing text. It fires where a number like 50 to 100 Units or 150 Units/kg is about to appear.

modes.label: Space before dose number
modes.description: A blank space after a phrase like 'starting dose is' or 'alfa', right before the number.
modes.example: The recommended starting dose for adult patients is<< >>50 to 100 Units

modes.label: Digit inside a number
modes.description: The first or middle digit of a dose or lab threshold number.
modes.example: increase dose to: <<3>>00 Units/kg three times per week

card.writes: It promotes odd word starts such as 'resist' and 'recom', with no clear link to dosing, so the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before a dose number in anemia drug dosing instructions, such as epoetin.
